messages:
maria_cs: heads-up — noticed onboarding nudges fired twice for the same contact this week; flagged 3 accounts where playbook ran duplicate touches. not sure if dedupe missed them or webhook replayed. cc @ryan_data @sam_backend
incidents-bot: [alert] airflow DAG `crm_dedupe_nightly` failed on 2026-03-20 02:07 UTC (Retrying) :warning:
ryan_data: looking into the airflow logs now. initial grep shows the DAG run overlapped with a worker restart window, so the dedupe job didn't finish cleanup of transient ids.
ryan_data: here's the snippet causing the overlap — the schedule was drifted after we bumped concurrency: 
```
# airflow DAG schedule
with DAG('crm_dedupe_nightly', schedule_interval='0 2 * * *', max_active_runs=1) as dag:
  t1 = PythonOperator(...)
```
sam_backend: i can add idempotency to the webhook handler to ignore duplicate touches within 24h. simple patch: check request.signature + contact_id and short-cache the event id. example: `if cache.exists(event_key): return 200`
olivia_csm: thanks — while we're here can we add a soft hold so enterprise/high-risk accounts don't get automated nudges? some of these duplicates hit high-touch customers and it looks bad.
jordan_ops: propose a playbook gating rule: add `nudge_hold` tag for accounts where `renewal_risk >= 70` OR `account_tier = 'Enterprise'` AND `last_manual_touch < 14`. the playbook should skip auto-send when tag present. SQL-ish condition: `update accounts set nudge_hold = true where renewal_score >= 0.7 and last_manual_touch < now() - interval '14 days'`
maria_cs: that sounds right. can we also ensure the dedupe job marks canonical_contact_id so playbook lookup uses canonical and not raw ids? observed duplicates were the same person across two contact records.
ryan_data: yes — will extend the dedupe output to include `canonical_contact_id` and backfill mapping for the last 90 days. i'll run a dry query to estimate how many rows change. dashboard: https://dash.internal.redwood/queries/dup-nudge-rate (will update after dry run) :eyes:
sam_backend: timeline-wise I can deploy the webhook idempotency and playbook skip flag in the next deploy window (tomorrow 10:00 UTC). I'll add a feature flag `nudge_hold_enabled` so we can rollback quickly.
olivia_csm: i'll coordinate enablement messaging and prepare a short script for manual review flow for accounts with `nudge_hold`. want a smoke test before turning on for prod.
jordan_ops: for automation ops — recommend a nightly maintenance window after dedupe completes where we re-run playbook candidate selection to avoid mid-run overlap. also add a metric `auto_nudge_duplicates` to CloudWatch.
maria_cs: perfect. can someone own the rollout checklist? items: 1) deploy webhook patch behind FF, 2) run dedupe dry-run & apply mappings, 3) enable playbook skip flag for held accounts, 4) smoke test on staging enterprise cohort, 5) flip FF in prod if green. tagging @sam_backend @ryan_data @olivia_csm
sam_backend: i'll own deploy and FF. planning deploy tomorrow 10:00 UTC, smoke test 11:00 UTC staging.
ryan_data: i'll run the dedupe dry-run tonight and post the estimate. if it's >5k mappings we should throttle back the backfill and do incremental windows.
olivia_csm: i'll organize enablement for the staging smoke test and grab 10 accounts to validate. scheduling note: prefer 11:30 UTC so APAC folks can join. :thumbsup:
maria_cs: awesome — please post results here once the dry-run and smoke test complete. thanks team! :pray:
